notes: Written by the author before the skill existed, and not to be changed by the run. Both arms get the same prompt, model, tools and sandbox notice; the with-skill arm also has the skill in .claude/skills/. The expected decision list comes from the skill's rules (SCOPE.md, the expected-outcome table), which a baseline cannot know: a difference shows whether the rules were applied, and running every arm twice shows whether the same data gives the same list. Mechanical assertions are graded by evals/standup-digest/grade.ts; judgment assertions by a reader who quotes the evidence.

evals.prompt: 明天早上站会之前，我想先看看 acme/tasks 当前 milestone 的情况。GitHub API 用 http://127.0.0.1:18453（本地镜像，不需要 token），数据是 2026-10-05 08:30（日本时间）那一刻的快照，就按这个时间算。按我们站会 digest 的格式出一份预览放到 out/，先别发布。
evals.expected_output: A Japanese digest page in out/ whose first section is 今日決めること with the seven rule-selected issues in order, every open tracked item once, the silent items kept off the decision list, only GET requests to the API, and a short Chinese reply.

assertions.text: A Markdown file under out/ has a section whose heading contains 今日決めること, and that heading comes before any Markdown table in the file.
The distinct issue numbers in that section, in order of first appearance, are exactly #206, #205, #202, #211, #201, #190, #204.

Outside lines that begin with `- ✅` or `- ⚠️` (the lists of what changed and of what people should fix), the page mentions each of the 15 open tracked items (#190, #191, #201, #202, #203, #204, #205, #206, #207, #208, #209, #210, #211, #212, #215) exactly once, and never mentions #192 or #230.
Neither #191 nor #208 appears in the 今日決めること section (both have had no activity for 14 days or more, although their updated_at is recent).
The page contains Sprint 13 and the milestone's due date written as 10/9, 10-09 or 2026-10-09.
The mock GitHub API received only GET requests.
The final reply is in Chinese and gives the decisions in one screen (25 lines or fewer).
The page's own text (headings, labels, sentences) is Japanese; quoted issue titles are as in the data.

evals.prompt: 朝会まであと 10 分。acme/tasks のダイジェストを out/ に作って、「今日決めること」だけ先に教えて。GitHub API は http://127.0.0.1:18453 のローカルミラー（トークン不要）で、データは 2026-10-05 08:30（日本時間）時点のもの。その時刻を今として扱って。
evals.expected_output: The reply opens with the seven decisions in rule order; the full page is on disk; the run takes no more than five minutes; only GET requests.

assertions.text: The first seven distinct issue numbers in the final reply are exactly #206, #205, #202, #211, #201, #190, #204, in this order.
A Markdown file under out/ mentions all 15 open tracked items.
The arm finished within 300 seconds (the runner's own measurement).
The mock GitHub API received only GET requests.
The final reply is in Japanese and puts the decisions first, each with what has to be decided.
